title: Hardware Interrupt
text: Trigger downstream function-call subsystems from interrupt service routine, 1 output, {Interrupt name} sets Select ISR; {Interrupt group} selects a peripheral ISR External, {Interrupt number} sets the position of ISR in interrupt table, {Events to serve} selects events EXTI0, {Simulink task priority} sets the priority of selected ISR, {Run interrupt service routine as atomic unit} selects to disable interrupt preemption and {Clear status after servicing each event} selects to clear interrupt status flags. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Interrupt group
params.values: Select a peripheral ISR External interrupts (EXTI) (default) | Analog to digital converter (ADC) | Pulse width modulation (PWM) | Direct memory access (DMA)

params.name: Interrupt name
params.values: Select ISR EXTI0_IRQHandler (default) | ADC_IRQHandler | TIM1_BRK_TIM9_IRQHandler | DMA0_Stream0_IRQHandler

params.name: Interrupt number
params.values: Position of ISR in interrupt table 21 (default) | 33 | 71 | …

params.name: Events to serve
params.values: Select events EXTI0 Event (default) | ADC1 OVR | Stream0 TC | …

params.name: Simulink task priority
params.values: Set priority of selected ISR 30 (default) | positive integer or nonnegative integer

params.name: Run interrupt service routine as atomic unit
params.values: Select to disable interrupt preemption off (default) | on

params.name: Clear status after servicing each event
params.values: Select to clear interrupt status flags off (default) | on
